latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Auto Cut:

- Automatically cuts silence, removes bad takes, and trims clips to highlights with a single prompt.
- Supports video uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB.
- Fast cloud rendering — edited clips ready in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session and API token management on first use.
- Exports videos in high-quality MP4 (up to 1080p).
- Ideal for creators seeking quick, hands-free edits.
